parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client-generated token to ensure request idempotency. This lets you safely retry the request without creating a duplicate diagnostic report. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.

parameters.name: DiagnoseType
parameters.description:
The diagnosis type. The only valid value is:

- Performance: performance diagnosis

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time for the diagnosis, in UTC. The time must be in the ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. Call the [DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ecs/developer-reference/api-ebs-2021-07-30-describeregions?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.i7) operation to find all regions supported by EBS Data Insight.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type. The only valid value is:

- Disk: a cloud disk

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time for the diagnosis, in UTC. The time must be in the ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ).
